security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline code formatting, and email-client names used for render QA. One medium-risk finding remains confirmed because SKILL.md documents a live Resend test-send command that can send email through an ESP. No prompt-injection attempt, credential theft, or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Live ESP render-test command in SKILL.md line 54.
remediation.suggestion: Show the dry-run form first, require explicit user confirmation before adding --live, and restrict sends to user-owned test inboxes.

content.value_statement: Email HTML often breaks across inboxes, dark mode, and image blocking. This skill turns approved copy into a responsive build with render QA and plain-text parity checks.
actual_capabilities: Builds a single-column, table-based HTML email from approved copy.
Checks dark-mode color behavior and records contrast issues.
Creates a client-render matrix for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.
Adds image-off fallback guidance, alt-text checks, and bulletproof CTA requirements.
Produces or compares a plain-text alternate for message and link parity.
Routes copy changes and final scoring to the correct related email skills.
limitations: It does not write subject lines, body copy, or CTA copy.
It does not compute SEND scores or make publish-gate decisions.
Unmeasured client results are estimates unless the user provides a seed or render test.
Live ESP sends require explicit user control and verified test inboxes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a campaign build
use_cases.description: Convert approved promotional copy into responsive HTML with dark-mode, image-off, and mobile checks.

use_cases.title: Fix inbox rendering defects
use_cases.description: Diagnose layout, button, image, or contrast problems reported in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, or mobile clients.

use_cases.title: Standardize handoff QA
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable render matrix and plain-text parity report before quality scoring or experiment design.

prompt_templates.title: Build from approved copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with copy and a destination URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved copy. Use this destination URL and check Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.

prompt_templates.title: QA an existing email
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with an existing HTML email.
prompt_templates.prompt: QA this email HTML for layout, dark mode, image-off behavior, accessibility, and plain-text parity. Mark untested client results as estimated.

prompt_templates.title: Repair client-specific breakage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request after a failed render preview.
prompt_templates.prompt: This email breaks in Outlook desktop and has poor dark-mode contrast. Identify the likely causes, fix the build, and explain remaining risks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare auditor-ready handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the final render-QA handoff for this built email. Include client labels, image-off fallbacks, accessibility status, and plain-text parity notes.

output_examples.input: Approved sale email copy, a product page URL, and brand colors.
output: Responsive email build summary with a 600px table layout.
Client matrix showing estimated Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android outcomes.

output_examples.input: Existing campaign HTML that fails in Outlook and hides the CTA when images are blocked.
output: Defect list with Outlook layout causes and image-off CTA risks.
Repair guidance for bulletproof buttons, fallback colors, and safer structure.
Open issues that require a measured inbox test.

output_examples.input: Newsletter HTML and a separate plain-text alternate.
output: Plain-text parity comparison for message, links, and primary CTA.
Accessibility notes for reading order, alt text, and descriptive links.
Handoff summary for the email quality auditor.

best_practices: Provide approved copy, destination URL, brand constraints, and target clients before building.
Label every client-render result as measured or estimated.
Use seed or inbox-preview tests for launch-critical campaigns.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to rewrite offer copy or subject lines.
Do not treat estimated render support as measured proof.
Do not rely on image-only CTAs or external stylesheets for essential content.

faq.question: Does this skill write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It builds and QA checks approved copy. Use the creative skill for writing or revising copy.

faq.question: Can it test every inbox automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can estimate common client behavior. Measured results require a seed test or render-preview result from the user.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks explicit colors, contrast, forced inversion risks, and logo visibility in dark-mode conditions.

faq.question: Can it create a plain-text version?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce or compare a plain-text alternate for message, link, and CTA parity.

faq.question: Does it send test emails?
faq.answer: It documents an optional Resend test-send workflow. Live sends should only run with explicit user confirmation and owned test inboxes.

faq.question: When should another skill be used?
faq.answer: Use the quality auditor for SEND scoring, the creative builder for copy changes, and the experiment designer for A/B tests.
